info.title: Contracts Finder (OCDS)
info.description: UK government contract notices as Open Contracting releases — keyless. Award releases carry the buyer, the winning supplier with its registered address, and the award value. The search CANNOT filter by supplier, place or text (parameters are accepted and ignored) — narrow AFTER the fetch. Windows use ISO instants; pagination is a cursor inside links.next.

get.summary: Contract notices published in a window, newest first, cursor-paged
get.description: `releases[]` are OCDS releases: `tender.title`, `buyer.name`, `parties[]` (role `supplier` carries `address.streetAddress` — the postcode is the tail of that text), `awards[].value.amount` and `awards[].date`. ~100-400 releases per business day feed-wide.

parameters.name: stages
parameters.description: `award` for awarded contracts; omit for all notice stages.

200.description: OCDS release package; releases[] may be empty for a quiet window.
